summary: Configured a persistent, secured NFSv4.2 share from node1 to node2. Both nodes use dataops UID/GID 4500; the shared directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770. Two-way access, denial for non-members, cleanup, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified. RHEL 10.0, the original kernel, SELinux enforcing mode, and firewalld remain intact.
actions_performed: Installed signed RHEL nfs-utils 2.8.3 packages and dependencies on both nodes without changing the OS release or kernel.
Created dataops UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Configured /srv/nfs/shared with owner dataops:dataops, mode 2770, and an SELinux-compatible label.
Restricted the rw,sync,root-squashed export and firewall access to node2 at 10.100.248.11.
Mounted the export persistently at /mnt/shared using NFSv4.2.
Verified two-way file creation and updates as dataops, consistent 4500:4500 ownership, modes 2770/660, and denied non-member access.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, proving changed boot identities and complete recovery after each restart.
Removed all test artifacts and confirmed the mounted share is empty and writable.

evidence.summary: Both systems report dataops UID 4500 and primary GID 4500 before and after restart.
The active export is restricted to node2 with rw,sync,root_squash; /srv/nfs/shared is 4500:4500, mode 2770, correctly labeled, and NFS is active and enabled.
An explicit unmount/mount-a test and the final post-restart state show /mnt/shared mounted from node1 via NFSv4.2 using the persistent fstab entry.

evidence.requirement: Two-way access, consistent ownership and permissions, and denied non-member access
evidence.summary: Fresh post-restart tests proved server-to-client and client-to-server I/O as dataops, 4500:4500 ownership, directory/file modes 2770/660, and denial for nobody.

evidence.requirement: Operating-system release, kernel, and security controls preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain RHEL 10.0 on kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; SELinux remains enforcing and firewalld remains active.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 254597f8-...; reboot acknowledged; management outage observed; new boot ID fd23f4ae-...; NFS export, data, security state, and live client I/O recovered.

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 7ef78016-...; reboot acknowledged; management outage observed; new boot ID 858802ec-...; the fstab mount, identities, permissions, security state, and server-visible client writes recovered.
All verification artifacts were removed; the share is empty, writable by dataops, mounted, exported, and both nodes report no failed systemd units.
